items:
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrrounding the work area is required.

Close manual 
 valve for Indicator line.
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.

Obtain copy of indicator setting values and 
 record it in its MRDS.

Connect 
 indicator 
 tester to indicator vent.

Inject the suitable pressure value reference to setting values and 
 record at MRDS, check if the reading is correct.

If there is any error,
 adjust the pressure indicator and repeat step 1 
 until reach the correct reading.
Return the pressure indicator to service by removing the pressure tester.

Return the pressure indicator back to its 
 location.

Open manual valve for
 pressure indicator line.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
This document 
outlines 
the checklist 
I1, for all types of pressure, temperature, flow, and level indicators, which must be carried out on 
an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the above title block.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 03 Jan 2003, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Close manual 
 valve for Indicator line.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes,
Pressure 
 tester.
Work to be carried out
Steps to prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of indicator setting values and 
 record it in its MRDS.
Open indicator vent.
Connect 
 indicator 
 tester to indicator vent.
Testing 
Procedure
Inject the suitable pressure value reference to setting values and 
 record at MRDS, check if the reading is correct.
If there is any error,
 adjust the pressure indicator and repeat step 1 
 until reach the correct reading.
Return indicator to 
service
Return the pressure indicator to service by removing the pressure tester.
Return the pressure indicator back to its 
 location.
Open manual valve for
 pressure indicator line.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
